scope: Proposition 8.3 (The inward bootstrap) of the manuscript “Almost-everywhere regularity of stationary integral varifolds” (preprints/Almost-everywhere-regularity-of-stationary-integral-varifolds-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 346 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f12bd8f9ace9a350), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 72. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On all sufficiently small radii, P is bounded above and below. For each fixed λ ∈ (0, 1) there are constants Cλ, cλ > 0 such that cλH(r) ≤ H(λr) ≤ CλH(r), ∫ r λr q∗(v) dv v ≤ Cλ. (8.19) There is a sequence rj ↓ 0 on which both n∗(rj) and q∗(rj) are bounded.
